_comment: Maps STATE_X -> list of state_trait_* keys to add to that state's traits = { ... } block. Consumed by resources.py during map_data/state_regions regeneration. Only NEW-mode traits go here; INJECT-mode traits (atacama_desert, bone_valley) extend vanilla traits already attached to vanilla states. See common/state_traits/te_mining_traits.txt and GH #110. An entry written "-state_trait_x" removes vanilla's trait from that state instead (test_state_trait_config.py).
_comment_copper_belts: 1.15 gives Katanga and Zambia vanilla's African Copper Belt (+20% copper mine throughput) and Antofagasta the Domeyko Fault (+10%): the same orebodies as the mod's Copperbelt (+20% copper, +10% nickel and cobalt) and Atacama Copper Belt (+20%). The vanilla trait goes, so each state shows one copper belt and keeps the figures it had on 1.14.5.
_comment_removals: Vanilla traits taken away or swapped where they contradict history (owner, 2026-11-01; Local Climate design § 4). Fiji and Tonga had no malaria (no Anopheles east of Vanuatu) and central Namibia almost none, so they lose vanilla's Severe Malaria; in Zambezi and Botswana malaria held the river valleys, not the highveld and the south-east where most people lived, so Severe becomes the mild trait.
